import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10**6)

def articulationPoints(V, adj):
    def dfs(node, parent, low, disc, visited, ap):
        nonlocal time
        children = 0
        visited[node] = True
        disc[node] = low[node] = time
        time += 1
        for neighbor in adj[node]:
            if neighbor == parent:
                continue
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                children += 1
                dfs(neighbor, node, low, disc, visited, ap)
                low[node] = min(low[node], low[neighbor])
                if parent != -1 and low[neighbor] >= disc[node]:
                    ap.add(node)
            else:
                low[node] = min(low[node], disc[neighbor])
        if parent == -1 and children > 1:
            ap.add(node)

    visited = [False] * V
    disc = [float('inf')] * V
    low = [float('inf')] * V
    ap = set()
    time = 0

    for i in range(V):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, low, disc, visited, ap)

    return sorted(ap) if ap else [-1]
